title: Pemba Island: Zanzibar's Green Sister
excerpt: Pemba, north of Zanzibar, is greener, hillier and much quieter. Excellent diving and real village life.
body:
Pemba is the second-largest island of the Zanzibar archipelago. It sees far fewer visitors than Unguja.

## Landscape

Hilly and green, with clove plantations, forests and mangroves.

## Diving

Pemba is known for its diving, with steep walls, healthy coral and good visibility. The Pemba Channel has strong currents and is better for experienced divers. See [diving in Tanzania](/blog/diving-in-tanzania/).

## Culture

Traditional villages and a quieter pace of life.

## Nature

Ngezi Forest is home to the Pemba flying fox, a large fruit bat.

## Getting there

By short domestic flight from Zanzibar or Dar es Salaam.

## Who it suits

Divers, couples and travellers who want peace.

Read our [Pemba page](/islands/pemba/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
